claim_text: A reported dietary gap warrants review of actual food intake and life-stage needs but does not automatically establish that a multivitamin/mineral is required.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Multivitamin/mineral fact sheet describes product variability and limitations of broad claims.
limitations: No generic product or dose; assess specific nutrients and existing products.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
